key_insight: ANXA1 enrichment relative to LGR5 marks an aggressive colorectal cancer phenotype associated with abundant stroma, macrophage enrichment and poorer prognosis.
clinical_relevance: Combined ANXA1/LGR5 assessment may support prognostic stratification, but this study does not establish treatment selection or drug discovery utility.
method: Dual-colour in situ hybridisation measured ANXA1 and LGR5 in tumour tissue from 2,163 SCOT trial patients.
AI-based digital pathology quantified marker-positive areas by tissue compartment and image-based molecular subtype.
Marker patterns were related to molecular features, immune context and survival using multivariable analyses.
evidence_signal: Combined markers improved prognostic discrimination over either alone; ANXA1 dominance independently predicted recurrence after adjustment (HR 1.43, 95% CI 1.08–1.90; p=0.014).
watch_item: These observational biomarker findings require independent validation and assay standardisation before clinical implementation.
paper_title: A regenerative stem cell phenotype marked by ANXA1 defines aggressive colorectal cancer biology
